pattern_name: Connectors + review (because, so, but, when, before/after)
pattern_name_ar: أدوات الربط + مراجعة (because, so, but, when, before/after)
formula: reason: because · result: so · contrast: but · time: when / before / after
when_to_use: Join short sentences into longer ones: because (reason), so (result), but (contrast), when/before/after (time).
when_to_use_ar: لربط الجمل القصيرة في جمل أطول: because (سبب)، so (نتيجة)، but (تضاد)، when/before/after (زمن).
why_arabic_speakers_struggle: Learners overuse 'and', confuse 'because' (reason) with 'so' (result), and sometimes use both 'because' and 'so' in one clause.

examples.en: I stayed home because I was tired.
examples.ar: بقيت في البيت لأني كنت متعبًا

examples.en: It was late, so we left.
Wash your hands before you eat.

common_errors.wrong: Because I was tired, so I stayed home.
common_errors.correct: Because I was tired, I stayed home.
common_errors.explanation: Use because OR so, not both.

common_errors.wrong: I called when I will arrive.
common_errors.explanation: Keep the tense consistent in the past.

practice_fill_blank.sentence: I stayed home ___ I was ill.
It was raining, ___ we took a taxi.
Brush your teeth ___ you go to bed.

quick_rule: because = reason · so = result · but = contrast · when/before/after = time. Never because + so together.
quick_rule_ar: because سبب · so نتيجة · but تضاد · when/before/after زمن. ومتجمعش because و so مع بعض.
mnemonic: REASON → because. RESULT → so. Never both.
connect_to_speaking: Tell a short story with connectors: 'I woke up late because I was tired, so I missed the bus, but I still arrived on time.'
